hana_cs: Heads-up: Novae (acct StablePool) is scheduled for dedicated capacity cutover Thu 09:00 PT. We need final quota numbers, autoscale policy, and a validated load test plan by Wed EOD.

sam_ops: I'll run the load harness. Proposed profile: baseline 300 rps steady, ramp to 1.2k over 20m, sustain 1.2k for 15m, then two 3m bursts to 2.5k. Also want a 90m cold-start soak to watch KV cache ramp. Need confirmation on avg/95/99 SLO targets.

hana_cs: Customer SLOs: p50 < 250ms, p95 < 800ms for interactive flows. For long-context chat flows (avg length ~550 tokens, 99th ~1,200 tokens) allow p95 up to 1s during bursts. Cost cap: daily spend must not exceed $7k for first 48h without explicit approval.

leo_sre: Given long contexts, batching will be smaller; plan reserved pool = 5x baseline GPUs for 12h then scale to demand. Recommend pre-warming KV cache using shadow replay and using longer prefix TTLs for the first 6h. I'll open OPS ticket #OPS-10101 for autoscale rules & canary.

jia_devex: Draft autoscale policy: min_nodes=4, max_nodes=40, scale_increment=+3, evaluation_window=60s, cooldown=180s. Add burst bucket: allow transient +30% headroom for up to 5m. Fallback policy: if error_rate > 0.8% OR p95 > 1.2s for 2 windows -> route 25% to quantized fallback model automatically. Agree?

hana_cs: Fine. Also request a replay capture run against staging to validate tokenization edge cases (emoji, long code blocks). Sam, can you capture per-request token histograms and KV hit rate?

sam_ops: Yes. I'll set up replay Wed 02:30 PT using sanitized traces. Need path to sanitized bundle and example long-request templates from Novae. Hana, please upload to gs://redwood-cs/novae/sanitized/ and paste path here.

deploy-bot: Reserved pool allocation pending: request by @leo_sre for account 'StablePool'  ticket CS-8120

leo_sre: Opening canary plan in OPS: route 5% -> reserved pool for first 90m, auto-increase if indicators stable. Will attach graph dashboards and a per-route spend alert. Ticket #OPS-10101.

jia_devex: I'll add a small rollback snippet and a quick inspection checklist. Rollback example:
```bash
# switch to smaller-quant model routing for account
redwoodctl routing update --account novae --route default --model gpt-small-8q --weight 1.0
```

hana_cs: Important: Put a spend forecast monitor for first 6h and 24h. If forecast > 110% of budget, auto-throttle non-critical traffic (batch embeddings/job endpoints). Also, collect qualitative feedback: two-question form for Novae engineers: "Did you observe regressions?" and "Any surprising cost/latency patterns?"

sam_ops: Load test checklist I'll run: 1) validate steady 300 rps; 2) ramp and sustain 1.2k; 3) burst to 2.5k; 4) KV warmup curve and hit-rate at 5,15,30,60m; 5) GPU mem, util, and GC pauses; 6) inject node OOM / 10% packet loss and observe fallback. I will log to /tmp/novae-load-<ts>.json and upload after run.

leo_sre: Add metrics to watch: route_error_rate, token_per_request, kv_hitrate, kv_miss_latency, gpu_memory_free, batch_size_distribution, tail_latency_traces. We'll enable trace sampling 100% for canary traffic first hour.

hana_cs: Novae asked for an E2E rehearsal window where they can exercise the client-side tokenization and ensure no truncation. Can we schedule a short client-roundtrip test Tue 18:00 PT?

sam_ops: Yep scheduled. I'll also run a tokenizer diffs script:
```python
# tokenizer diff quick check
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
# run diff between prod tokenizer and novae samples
```

jia_devex: I'll produce the concise runbook and link the tickets CS-8120 & OPS-10101. Adding a troubleshooting section for common post-cutover issues (KV cold miss storms, small batch tail latency, model fallback stuck).

leo_sre: Safety knobs: enable automatic fallback ramp-down if cumulative spend anomaly detected AND latency stable. Add an incident hook to page SRE on >2% error rate sustained 10m.

hana_cs: I'll collect Novae PM and infra engineer availability for Wed and Thu. Also will confirm KMS scopes and any PII gating on traces. Once sanitized bundle is uploaded I'll ping Sam.

sam_ops: After replay I'll post short results here: p50/p95/p99, kv_hitrate curve, and whether any tokenization mismatches were found. If anything odd, we'll hold cutover.

hana_cs: Thanks all  sync Wed 09:30 PT to review final numbers. :thumbsup:
